title: Ministry of Angels
definition: The ministry of angels is their God-directed service in worship, protection, message-bearing, judgment, and care for God's people.
summary: Angels serve God's purposes and minister according to His command.
christFocus: Angels minister under Christ's authority and serve the purposes of the Gospel and God's kingdom.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Angels minister according to God's will. Scripture shows angels strengthening, protecting, delivering messages, executing judgment, and serving God's people.

Their ministry is real but not autonomous. Angels do not replace God, the Holy Spirit, Scripture, prayer, or the Church. They act as servants under the Lord's command.

The ministry of angels should encourage believers that God's care is greater than what can be seen. Yet Scripture never directs believers to seek angels; it directs them to seek God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some people become obsessed with angelic activity while others dismiss the unseen realm entirely. The ministry of angels matters because it teaches confidence in God's care without misplaced devotion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Thank God for His unseen care, but do not seek experiences with angels. Pray to the Father through Christ and trust that God commands all His servants wisely.
